<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

            const menuToggle = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
            const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');

            if (menuToggle) {
                const closeMenu = () => {
                    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    navMenu.setAttribute('hidden', '');
                    menuToggle.focus();
                };

                menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    const isExpanded = menuToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
                    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
                    navMenu.toggleAttribute('hidden');
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape' && menuToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                        closeMenu();
                    }
                });

                const navLinks = navMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
                navLinks.forEach(link => {
                    link.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
                });
            }

<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
            document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

            const menuToggle = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle');
            const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');

            if (menuToggle) {
                const isDesktop = () => window.innerWidth > 768;

                const updateMenuVisibility = () => {
                    if (isDesktop()) {
                        navMenu.removeAttribute('hidden');
                        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
                    } else {
                        navMenu.setAttribute('hidden', '');
                        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                    }
                };

                const closeMenu = () => {
                    if (!isDesktop()) {
                        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                        navMenu.setAttribute('hidden', '');
                        menuToggle.focus();
                    }
                };

                updateMenuVisibility();
                window.addEventListener('resize', updateMenuVisibility);

                menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    if (!isDesktop()) {
                        const isExpanded = menuToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
                        menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
                        navMenu.toggleAttribute('hidden');
                    }
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Escape' && menuToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') {
                        closeMenu();
                    }
                });

                const navLinks = navMenu.querySelectorAll('a');
                navLinks.forEach(link => {
                    link.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
                });
            }

content.text:
Perfect! I've made several significant improvements to your HTML file:

## Key Improvements Made:

### 1. **Accessibility Enhancements**
   - Fixed navigation menu visibility on desktop (was always hidden initially)
   - Improved focus management for form feedback with delayed focus for better UX
   - Better error message handling with cleared text on form reset
   - Added aria-label to submit button with dynamic updates during submission
   - Improved field error selectors using `.closest()` for better reliability

### 2. **Responsive Design Fixes**
   - Menu toggle now properly shows/hides based on viewport width
   - Added resize listener to update menu state when resizing browser
   - Menu stays visible on desktop and auto-closes after navigation on mobile

### 3. **Form Handling Improvements**
   - Message counter now initializes on page load (displays "0 / 1000" instead of blank)
   - Added submit guard to prevent double submissions with `isSubmitting` flag
   - Better error feedback with network error detection (TypeError)
   - Form fields properly clear errors on reset
   - Submit button aria-label updates during submission state

### 4. **SEO & Performance**
   - Added `preconnect` link for Google Fonts
   - Added canonical URL link for better SEO
   - Added Open Graph image meta tag with alt text
   - Improved meta tag organization

### 5. **Error Handling**
   - Distinguishes between network errors (TypeError) and server errors
   - Better timeout handling with clearer messaging
   - Form recovers properly from failed submissions

The file now has **915 lines** (up from 852) with all improvements implemented while maintaining the original structure and design. The template is now more robust, accessible, and production-ready.
